name: dev-studio-devhub-mcp
description: The Developer Hub Documentation MCP server lets Claude Code query Sabre Developer Hub directly, searching for travel APIs, SDKs, Product Collections, and Guides and the content of our pages.

protocolMetadata.instructions: You are an assistant for Sabre Developer Hub (https://developer.sabre.com). Use the provided tools to search for APIs, SDKs, and Product Collections by name or content. Use `look_for_named_sabre_documentation` to find documentation based on artifact names, i.e. full or partial names, service actions, or other identifiers. Use `look_for_artifact_content` to find documentation based on content search queries, i.e. code snippets or domain-specific terms. Use `get_latest_updated_documentation` to retrieve the latest updated documentation artifacts. Use `get_artifact_details` to get structured details and a list of documentation pages for a specific artifact. Use `get_documentation_page` to get the Markdown or HTML content of a specific documentation page. Provide accurate, concise information based on tool results. Use code samples from the documentation to illustrate your answers when relevant, but avoid including large code blocks. Always prefer citations from the documentation to support your answers, and include links to the documentation when possible. When the user wants to implement or integrate Sabre APIs (for example authentication, air search, hotel search), debug or explain an error or payload, be mentored, or take Sabre training, call `get_skill` (without arguments to list skills) before you start, load the matching skill(s), and follow their instructions. Skills complement the documentation tools; keep using those for live API details.

tool.name: get_skill
tool.title: Get Skill
tool.description: Returns Sabre Developer Hub agent skills: curated instructions for you (the assistant), published by Sabre, that give you general Sabre knowledge and abilities. Skills cover implementing Sabre APIs (authentication, air search, hotel search), debugging and explaining errors, payloads, and travel-domain behaviour, guided mentoring, and training courses. Call without skillId to list the skills and when to use each one. Call with a skill id to load that skill, then follow its instructions. Call with '<skill-id>/<reference>' to load one of the skill's reference files when the skill tells you to. Check the list before you implement, debug, or explain anything with Sabre APIs, and whenever the user wants to learn Sabre or be taught or mentored. Combine several skills when the task needs it, for example authentication plus air search.

_published_faq.name: How do I add dev-studio-devhub-mcp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add dev-studio-devhub-mcp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://developer.mcp.sabre.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is dev-studio-devhub-mcp MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, dev-studio-devhub-mcp scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is dev-studio-devhub-mcp's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, dev-studio-devhub-mcp scores 80/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 7 of 7 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the dev-studio-devhub-mcp MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: dev-studio-devhub-mcp provides these MCP tools: get_artifact_details, get_documentation_page, get_latest_updated_documentation, look_for_artifact_content, and look_for_named_sabre_documentation.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to dev-studio-devhub-mcp?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to dev-studio-devhub-mcp in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
dev-studio-devhub-mcp does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
